newsitem.title: USA: Duckwall-ALCO Q4 net up on growth plan.
newsitem.headline: Duckwall-ALCO Q4 net up on growth plan.

text.p: Duckwall-ALCO Stores Inc said Tuesday a focus on its growth strategy helped earnings climb in the fourth quarter ended February 2.
The company, which operates 186 stores in the central United States, reported net income of $3.4 million, or $0.67 a share, versus $2.9 million, or $0.73 a share a year ago.
The number of authorized common shares were 5.1 million in 1997 cersus 4.0 million in 1996, the company said.
Duckwall-ALCO officials said changing its marketing programs also helped improve gross margins.
The company's shares were down 1/4 Tuesday at 13-3/4.
